description: This file defines API routes related to linking and retrieving GitHub repositories associated with projects within an organization, including user authentication, project validation, and database operations.

classes.name: ProjectGithubLink
classes.description: Schema representing the linkage between a project and a GitHub repository.

methods.name: dict _get_current_user_payload(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Extracts and validates user info from Bearer token in Authorization header.

methods.name: None _assert_project_in_org(conn, project_id: str, org_id: str)
methods.description: Checks if the specified project belongs to the given organization.

methods.name: ProjectGithubLink link_github_repo_to_project( project_id: str = Path(..., description="Project ID to link the repository to"), data: ProjectGithubLinkCreate = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: API endpoint that links a GitHub repository to a specified project.

methods.description: API endpoint that retrieves the GitHub repository linked to a specific project.
